title: 5th July 2024 @ 2:47pm - DGAC-Facilitated Removal
subtitle: Jetbridge Standoff — Full Confrontation
location: Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport (SCL), Santiago, Chile — Aboard Aircraft / Jetbridge
classification: Attorney Work Product — Privileged and Confidential

cluster_A_escalating_allegations.summary: Stewardess returns with 'golpeo' allegation; passenger challenges, demands proof, offers conditional departure. Stewardess calls security. Joaquín Barraza arrives, invokes captain's authority. Allegation shifts from 'golpeo' to 'boarding not authorized.'

cluster_B_dgac_third_narrative.summary: DGAC arrives and introduces third justification: passenger allegedly self-scanned boarding pass. Passenger identifies the narrative shift in real time. DGAC claims camera evidence but offers circular solution (disembark to prove innocence).

cluster_C_witness_interventions.summary: Multiple fellow passengers intervene. Pasajera 3 identifies shifting versions; Pasajero 4 warns removal will be recorded. Barraza denies mentioning aggression. Passenger states second accusation was 'no mostré mi billete.' DGAC radios 'no hay caso.'

cluster_D_pdi_investigation.summary: PDI arrives and admits information vacuum: 'lo unico que han mencionado e que... nada.' PDI confirms aggression allegation was never mentioned to them. DGAC identifies as Aeronáutica Civil. Passenger explains full sequence.

cluster_E_forced_removal.summary: Physical removal executed. DGAC: 'debemos desembarcar a la persona. ¡Ahora!' Passenger documents physical contact: 'No toques, tú no puedes tocarme' and 'agresión, agresión.' DGAC threatens: 'te voy a empujar.' Passenger challenges: 'los motivos son cambiados, ¿por qué fue cambiado?' DGAC admits they defer to airline: 'Los motivos los dio la compañía.' Passenger explains divorce/family context amid removal.

key_evidentiary_findings.finding: Three distinct removal justifications in one recording: golpeo → boarding denied → self-scanned boarding pass. Shift documented in real time by passenger and Pasajera 3.
Stewardess admitted hearsay: 'eso es lo que me indican.' Barraza later denied mentioning aggression: 'No mencione nada sobre agression.'
Camera evidence invoked by LATAM/DGAC but never produced. Barraza: 'No se puede traer ahora.'
PDI admitted information vacuum: 'lo unico que han mencionado e que... nada.' Aggression allegation withheld from PDI.
Pasajera 3 independently identified shifting narratives: 'han venido con distintas versiones.'
DGAC admits non-verification: 'se verifica con la compañía, no lo podemos verificar en el avión.'
Physical force used: 'te voy a empujar.' Passenger documented: 'agresión, agresión.' Removal recorded by multiple passengers.
Passenger repeatedly offered conditional departure: leave if shown proof. Never engaged by any authority.
Passenger revealed personal context amid removal: divorcing Chilean spouse, has a daughter in Chile, lives in Chile.
